note: Frames are 60 fps from the effect's start. The crescents sweep in for 4 frames before contact, so the effect fires 0.067 s before the hit.
story: A fast one-handed chop. Two gold crescents sweep in during the last frames of the wind-up, the blade's path drawn as light. At contact, a 2-frame white core snaps on with rays, then shards and line bursts scatter along the cut and stop, and a few embers drift off as the arm recovers.

beats.name: Swing
beats.intent: two gold crescents sweep in along the blade's path, the tail eroding

beats.name: Hit
beats.intent: a white core snaps on at contact for 2 frames

beats.name: Scatter
beats.intent: shards burst along the cut and stop dead; embers drift off
